q: Need a Donchian breakout system on the 15. When flat, go long if the close is above the 48-bar high or get short if it's below the 48-bar low, but check the trend filter on the 1h where the last completed close must be above its 20 EMA for longs or below for shorts. Size in with vol, risking 1% of equity per 1 ATR, capped at 1.0 and floored at 0.05. Trail it with a stop sitting 1.5 ATR behind the extreme price reached, let it run for up to 128 bars before a time stop gets you flat on the next open, and flip short or long if an opposite signal prints.

attempts.text: Need a Donchian breakout system on the 15. When flat, go long if the close is above the 48-bar high or get short if it's below the 48-bar low, but check the trend filter on the 1h where the last completed close must be above its 20 EMA for longs or below for shorts. Size in with vol, risking 1% of equity per 1 ATR, capped at 1.0 and floored at 0.05. Trail it with a stop sitting 1.5 ATR behind the extreme price reached, let it run for up to 128 bars before a time stop gets you flat on the next open, and flip short or long if an opposite signal prints.

spec_desc:
- Entry signal: Donchian channel breakout. Bullish whenever the close is strictly above the highest high of the 48 bars before the current bar; bearish whenever the close is strictly below the lowest low of those 48 bars. This is a level condition, true on every bar it holds.
- Direction: long and short (a bullish signal opens a long when flat, a bearish one opens a short when flat).
- Trend filter on completed 60-minute candles: only take long entries when the last completed 60-minute close is strictly above the 20-period EMA of those candles' closes, and only take short entries when it is strictly below. The filter only blocks entries, never exits.
- Position size: volatility-scaled. Fraction of equity = 0.01 x close / (1 x ATR(14)) on the signal bar, capped at 1.0 and floored at 0.05.
- Time stop: if the trade is still open 128 bars after the signal bar, exit at the next open (decide on the bar where bars-since-signal reaches 128).
- Trailing stop: track the best price of the trade (highest high for longs, lowest low for shorts, starting from the entry price and updated with each bar's high/low while the position is held); the stop sits 1.5 x entry ATR behind that extreme.
- A signal in the opposite direction of an open trade closes it at the next open.

q: Build a long-only MACD 5, 35, 5 crossover strategy on the 15-minute chart with a 240-minute trend filter requiring the 4h close above its 20 EMA. Enter half size when flat on a bullish crossover. Pyramid once by adding another 0.5 size when price moves at least 2 entry ATRs in our favor since the last add, max 1 add per trade. Move the stop to breakeven once price hits at least 1 entry ATR in profit, then activate a trailing stop 2 entry ATRs behind the trade extreme high. Flip short or an opposite signal closes the trade.

attempts.text: Build a long-only MACD 5, 35, 5 crossover strategy on the 15-minute chart with a 240-minute trend filter requiring the 4h close above its 20 EMA. Enter half size when flat on a bullish crossover. Pyramid once by adding another 0.5 size when price moves at least 2 entry ATRs in our favor since the last add, max 1 add per trade. Move the stop to breakeven once price hits at least 1 entry ATR in profit, then activate a trailing stop 2 entry ATRs behind the trade extreme high. Flip short or an opposite signal closes the trade.

spec_desc:
- Entry signal: MACD(5,35,5) line crossing its signal line. Bullish when the MACD line crosses above the signal line (at or below on the previous bar, strictly above now); bearish on the cross below.
- Direction: long only (bearish signals only close longs).
- Trend filter on completed 240-minute candles: only take long entries when the last completed 240-minute close is strictly above the 20-period EMA of those candles' closes, and only take short entries when it is strictly below. The filter only blocks entries, never exits.
- Position size: start with 0.5 of equity, then pyramid. While in the trade, each time the close is at least 2 x the entry ATR beyond the price of the last add (initially the entry price) in the trade's favour, add another 0.5 (total capped at 1.0), at most 1 add(s) per trade; the add price becomes that bar's close.
- Breakeven: once a bar closes at least 1 x entry ATR in profit, move the stop to the entry price for the rest of the trade (it never moves back).
- Trailing stop: track the best price of the trade (highest high for longs, lowest low for shorts, starting from the entry price and updated with each bar's high/low while the position is held); the stop sits 2 x entry ATR behind that extreme. The trailing stop only becomes active once the breakeven rule has triggered.
- A signal in the opposite direction of an open trade closes it at the next open.

q: Spin up a 15-minute box breakout model trading both ways. Check the prior 16 bars for the box, valid if height is at most 6 ATR. On a close outside the box, check the 1h HTF trend filter, going long if the last completed 60-minute close is above the 20 EMA, and getting short if below. Size in at 50% equity. Scale out once a candle closes at least 3 ATR in profit by taking some off the table, cutting the position in half once per trade and letting the rest ride. Time stop after 32 bars on the open. An opposite signal closes the trade.

attempts.text: Spin up a 15-minute box breakout model trading both ways. Check the prior 16 bars for the box, valid if height is at most 6 ATR. On a close outside the box, check the 1h HTF trend filter, going long if the last completed 60-minute close is above the 20 EMA, and getting short if below. Size in at 50% equity. Scale out once a candle closes at least 3 ATR in profit by taking some off the table, cutting the position in half once per trade and letting the rest ride. Time stop after 32 bars on the open. spec_desc:
- Entry signal: range-box breakout. The box is the highest high and lowest low of the 16 bars before the current bar. It only counts as a box if its height (top minus bottom) is at most 6 times the current ATR(14). Bullish when the close is strictly above the top of a valid box; bearish when the close is strictly below its bottom.
- Direction: long and short (a bullish signal opens a long when flat, a bearish one opens a short when flat).
- Trend filter on completed 60-minute candles: only take long entries when the last completed 60-minute close is strictly above the 20-period EMA of those candles' closes, and only take short entries when it is strictly below. The filter only blocks entries, never exits.
- Position size: a fixed 0.5 of equity per trade.
- Scale out: the first time a bar closes at least 3 x entry ATR in profit, cut the position to half its current size (once per trade); the rest stays on.
- Time stop: if the trade is still open 32 bars after the signal bar, exit at the next open (decide on the bar where bars-since-signal reaches 32).
- A signal in the opposite direction of an open trade closes it at the next open.

Size in at 50% equity. Once we are in the green by at least 1 ATR at the close, move the stop to breakeven, and bank half when we hit 1.5 ATR. Cut it to flat if an opposite signal prints or if we hit 32 bars on the clock.

- Trend filter on completed 60-minute candles: only take long entries when the last completed 60-minute close is strictly above the 50-period EMA of those candles' closes, and only take short entries when it is strictly below. The filter only blocks entries, never exits.
- Position size: a fixed 0.5 of equity per trade.
- Breakeven: once a bar closes at least 1 x entry ATR in profit, move the stop to the entry price for the rest of the trade (it never moves back).
- Scale out: the first time a bar closes at least 1.5 x entry ATR in profit, cut the position to half its current size (once per trade); the rest stays on.
- Time stop: if the trade is still open 32 bars after the signal bar, exit at the next open (decide on the bar where bars-since-signal reaches 32).
